operationID.retry: same UUID for the same semantic transaction operation

signedTransactionJWS.format: ASCII compact JWS with exactly three dot-separated base64url segments; CR/LF rejected
signedTransactionJWS.logging: never store or echo raw JWS

request.callerControlledAuthorityFields: none: account, appAccountToken, environment, bundle, product, quantity, draw count, catalog, seed, pity, and result are not request fields

principal.source: out-of-band injected VerifiedPrincipalProvider; request body cannot assert identity
principal.default: deny before JWS processing or ledger lookup

serverPolicy.profile: fixed explicit Sandbox rehearsal profile; product allowlist, draw count, test seed, pool and candidate rules are server-side immutable configuration
serverPolicy.randomness: R459 deterministic test RNG only; never production RNG

historicalDelivery.drawReceiptAccountBinding: drawReceipt.accountIDSHA256 remains the R459 SHA-256 of accountID; it is distinct from response.accountBindingSHA256

deliveredItems.description: immutable candidate payload; stable gear UUIDs derived from operation UUID and ordered draw rows
deliveredItems.drawRowFingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the corresponding immutable R459 draw row

historicalDelivery.deliveryFingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical JSON {profileID,profileFingerprint,transactionIdentity,operationID,drawReceipt,deliveredItems}; excludes deliveryFingerprint itself

currentState.freshness: read in one read-only SQLite transaction on each response; never copied from cached historical receipt
currentState.operationStatusMeaning: delivered means this operation was historically committed; status refunded still blocks current redelivery

response.accountBindingSHA256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 stableBindingID from the out-of-band verified principal; opaque correlation only, not authentication
response.requestSHA256: hash of exact request bytes; not authentication

errorCode.sensitiveData: never includes token, JWS, raw payload, private key or filesystem path

response.encoding: Canonical UTF-8 JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN, exactly one trailing LF; exact request hash is over received request bytes.
response.businessRejectionCorrelation: after successful principal binding, a business rejection may include matching operationID/accountBindingSHA256 and the fresh currentState; auth/request rejects include null binding/currentState
response.transactionIdentityEncoding: R459 full six-field transaction identity; internal ledger key remains environment/bundleID/transactionID

crossLanguageFixture.encoding: request/response Base64 fields contain exact raw bytes; hashes cover exact bytes; synthetic signing key is never exported

sideEffects.ledger: existing R459 capability-bound rehearsal authority only; no duplicate purchase/draw SQL
sideEffects.save: no game-save write in Python service

acceptance: default provider rejects before JWS verification or ledger lookup
principal/account/token mismatch rejects before ledger mutation
strict request schema and canonical UUID validation
same operation retry returns same historical delivery and a fresh current-state snapshot
changed transaction under the same operation UUID is rejected by ledger idempotency collision
refund/debt state is freshly reflected and cannot be replaced by an old successful delivery
successful and rejected responses never claim production authorization
